column1: # Expected classification per fixture. classification_basis is asserted as a
# substring, so wording may be refined without breaking the test, while the
# class and the REASON CATEGORY stay pinned.
# 120 bp. Holding size constant is the entire point of the pair: identical
# size, different claim, different class. Any difference in these two lengths
# would let a reader wonder whether the boundary mattered after all.
# bycon_cnv_live.json is a REAL record and the most important row here: it has
# no variantType field at all, so an abundance rule looking only there would
# drop every CNV this live provider holds straight through to unclassified.
